Definition: Kenath, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Kenath was a town east of the Jordan that Nobah took and renamed after himself, and it is counted among the sixty cities of Jair in Gilead. A conquered town, a new name, and a place in the record.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe places change names and owners, but God keeps the record, and Kenath is remembered because his people walked there.
